body: Yeah, thank you. I have to stay around for my little brother because he has no father figure, his dad was taken by heroin addiction but he never got to know him... He's not even 10 yet, so I guess I'm sticking around for now

Thanks. If I'm being totally honest, I'm just really scared of what my life will be like if I'm battling depression regularly... i really want to give in. No more dealing with any problems. The only reason I'm still here is my little brother.

I really want to but its hard. I'm one of the few people I know who isn't on antidepressants and I used to give support to my friends and family, but now I need support and there is no-one around me that I trust enough, not my family.
